blocks.name: 驱动循环
blocks.summary: 反复 step 直到全部完成
blocks.explain: 连续批处理的心脏：不等一条序列生成完，每轮 step 都重新组批——新来的请求和在跑的解码混在一批里，GPU 始终喂饱。

cards.name: LLMEngine.step()
cards.code:
def step(self):
        seqs, is_prefill = self.scheduler.schedule()
        num_tokens = sum(seq.num_scheduled_tokens for seq in seqs) if is_prefill else -len(seqs)
        token_ids = self.model_runner.call("run", seqs, is_prefill)
        self.scheduler.postprocess(seqs, token_ids, is_prefill)
        outputs = [(seq.seq_id, seq.completion_token_ids) for seq in seqs if seq.is_finished]
        return outputs, num_tokens

terms.note: 整批同型标志：一轮要么全 prefill、要么全 decode，attention 据此切两条路径。

cards.name: Scheduler.schedule()

blocks.name: 组 prefill 批
blocks.summary: 优先填新请求，受 token 预算约束
blocks.explain: prefill 吃显存也吃算力：只在 token 预算内塞新序列；预算不足时只允许「批里第一条」做分块预填，其余留到下轮。

blocks.name: 组 decode 批
blocks.summary: 每条在跑序列各推 1 个 token
blocks.explain: decode 阶段每序列只前进 1 个 token；若某序列要新块而池子空了，就抢占队尾序列（甚至自己）来腾显存。

terms.note: 本轮已排进批的 token 数，用来卡住 max_num_batched_tokens 预算。
前缀缓存能复用的块数；-1 表示空闲块不够，这条得等下轮。

cards.name: Scheduler.postprocess()
cards.code:
def postprocess(self, seqs: list[Sequence], token_ids: list[int], is_prefill: bool):
        for seq, token_id in zip(seqs, token_ids):
            self.block_manager.hash_blocks(seq)
            seq.num_cached_tokens += seq.num_scheduled_tokens
            seq.num_scheduled_tokens = 0
            if is_prefill and seq.num_cached_tokens < seq.num_tokens:
                continue
            seq.append_token(token_id)
            if (not seq.ignore_eos and token_id == self.eos) \
                    or seq.num_completion_tokens == seq.max_tokens:
                seq.status = SequenceStatus.FINISHED
                self.block_manager.deallocate(seq)
                self.running.remove(seq)

terms.note: 已算进 KV cache 的 token 数；prefill 分块时用它判断整段是否填完。

cards.name: Scheduler.preempt()
cards.code:
def preempt(self, seq: Sequence):
        seq.status = SequenceStatus.WAITING
        seq.is_prefill = True
        self.block_manager.deallocate(seq)
        self.waiting.appendleft(seq)

cards.name: ModelRunner.run()
cards.code:
def run(self, seqs: list[Sequence], is_prefill: bool) -> list[int]:
        input_ids, positions = self.prepare_prefill(seqs) \
                               if is_prefill else self.prepare_decode(seqs)
        temperatures = self.prepare_sample(seqs) if self.rank == 0 else None
        logits = self.run_model(input_ids, positions, is_prefill)
        token_ids = self.sampler(logits, temperatures).tolist() if self.rank == 0 else None
        reset_context()
        return token_ids

cards.name: ModelRunner.prepare_prefill()
cards.code:
def prepare_prefill(self, seqs: list[Sequence]):
        input_ids = []
        positions = []
        cu_seqlens_q = [0]
        cu_seqlens_k = [0]
        max_seqlen_q = 0
        max_seqlen_k = 0
        slot_mapping = []
        block_tables = None
        for seq in seqs:
            start = seq.num_cached_tokens
            seqlen_q = seq.num_scheduled_tokens
            end = start + seqlen_q
            seqlen_k = end
            input_ids.extend(seq[start:end])
            positions.extend(range(start, end))
            cu_seqlens_q.append(cu_seqlens_q[-1] + seqlen_q)
            cu_seqlens_k.append(cu_seqlens_k[-1] + seqlen_k)
            max_seqlen_q = max(seqlen_q, max_seqlen_q)
            max_seqlen_k = max(seqlen_k, max_seqlen_k)
            if not seq.block_table:    # warmup
                continue
            start_block = start // self.block_size
            end_block = (end + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size
            for i in range(start_block, end_block):
                slot_start = seq.block_table[i] * self.block_size
                if i == start_block:
                    slot_start += start % self.block_size
                if i != end_block - 1:
                    slot_end = seq.block_table[i] * self.block_size + self.block_size
                else:
                    slot_end = seq.block_table[i] * self.block_size + end - i * self.block_size
                slot_mapping.extend(range(slot_start, slot_end))
        if cu_seqlens_k[-1] > cu_seqlens_q[-1]:    # prefix cache
            block_tables = self.prepare_block_tables(seqs)
        input_ids = torch.tensor(input_ids, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=True).cuda(non_blocking=True)
        positions = torch.tensor(positions, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=True).cuda(non_blocking=True)
        cu_seqlens_q = torch.tensor(cu_seqlens_q, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True).cuda(non_blocking=True)
        cu_seqlens_k = torch.tensor(cu_seqlens_k, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True).cuda(non_blocking=True)
        slot_mapping = torch.tensor(slot_mapping, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True).cuda(non_blocking=True)
        set_context(True, cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k, max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k, slot_mapping, None, block_tables)
        return input_ids, positions

blocks.name: 逐序列建 slot_mapping
blocks.summary: 算每个 token 落哪个物理槽
blocks.explain: slot_mapping 是逻辑到物理的翻译表：block_table 给出逻辑块号，乘 block_size 加块内偏移，得到 KV cache 里每个 token 的绝对槽位。

blocks.name: 搬上 GPU
blocks.summary: 张量 pin+异步拷贝，写进全局 Context

terms.note: 长度 = 本批 token 数，每项是该 token 在 KV cache 里的绝对物理槽位。

blocks.name: decode 走 CUDA Graph
blocks.summary: 定长重放，省 kernel launch 开销
blocks.explain: decode 每轮 batch 很小、形状固定，用预先 capture 的 CUDA Graph 重放，绕开 Python 逐 kernel 派发的开销。

cards.name: Sampler.forward()
cards.code:
@torch.compile
    def forward(self, logits: torch.Tensor, temperatures: torch.Tensor):
        logits = logits.float().div_(temperatures.unsqueeze(dim=1))
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        sample_tokens = probs.div_(torch.empty_like(probs).exponential_(1).clamp_min_(1e-10)) \
                             .argmax(dim=-1)
        return sample_tokens

cards.name: BlockManager.__init__()
cards.code:
def __init__(self, num_blocks: int, block_size: int):
        self.block_size = block_size
        self.blocks: list[Block] = [Block(i) for i in range(num_blocks)]
        self.hash_to_block_id: dict[int, int] = dict()
        self.free_block_ids: deque[int] = deque(range(num_blocks))
        self.used_block_ids: set[int] = set()

terms.note: 空闲物理块号的队列——分页显存的自由列表。
内容哈希→物理块号，前缀缓存靠它命中已算过的 KV。

cards.name: BlockManager.can_allocate()

blocks.name: 余量判定
blocks.summary: 空闲块够不够，返回可复用块数

cards.name: BlockManager.allocate()
cards.code:
def allocate(self, seq: Sequence, num_cached_blocks: int):
        assert not seq.block_table
        h = -1
        for i in range(num_cached_blocks):
            token_ids = seq.block(i)
            h = self.compute_hash(token_ids, h)
            block_id = self.hash_to_block_id[h]
            block = self.blocks[block_id]
            if block_id in self.used_block_ids:
                block.ref_count += 1
            else:
                block.ref_count = 1
                self.free_block_ids.remove(block_id)
                self.used_block_ids.add(block_id)
            seq.block_table.append(block_id)
        for i in range(num_cached_blocks, seq.num_blocks):
            seq.block_table.append(self._allocate_block())
        seq.num_cached_tokens = num_cached_blocks * self.block_size

blocks.name: 复用已缓存块
blocks.summary: 命中前缀就 ref_count+1 共享
blocks.explain: 前缀缓存的省显存点：多条序列若共享同一段 prompt 前缀，物理块只存一份，靠 ref_count 记录被几条序列引用。

blocks.name: 补分配新块
blocks.summary: 剩余部分从空闲池取新块

terms.note: 共享计数：几条序列引用这个物理块，减到 0 才真正回收。

cards.name: BlockManager.may_append()

terms.note: 每块固定装 block_size 个 token；刚好跨到新块的第 1 个 token 时才追加一块。

cards.name: BlockManager.hash_blocks()
cards.code:
def hash_blocks(self, seq: Sequence):
        start = seq.num_cached_tokens // self.block_size
        end = (seq.num_cached_tokens + seq.num_scheduled_tokens) // self.block_size
        if start == end: return
        h = self.blocks[seq.block_table[start - 1]].hash if start > 0 else -1
        for i in range(start, end):
            block = self.blocks[seq.block_table[i]]
            token_ids = seq.block(i)
            h = self.compute_hash(token_ids, h)
            block.update(h, token_ids)
            self.hash_to_block_id[h] = block.block_id

cards.name: BlockManager.deallocate()
Attention.forward()
cards.code:
def forward(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor):
        context = get_context()
        k_cache, v_cache = self.k_cache, self.v_cache
        if k_cache.numel() and v_cache.numel():
            store_kvcache(k, v, k_cache, v_cache, context.slot_mapping)
        if context.is_prefill:
            if context.block_tables is not None:    # prefix cache
                k, v = k_cache, v_cache
            o = flash_attn_varlen_func(q, k, v,
                                       max_seqlen_q=context.max_seqlen_q,
                                       cu_seqlens_q=context.cu_seqlens_q,
                                       max_seqlen_k=context.max_seqlen_k,
                                       cu_seqlens_k=context.cu_seqlens_k,
                                       softmax_scale=self.scale, causal=True,
                                       block_table=context.block_tables)
        else:    # decode
            o = flash_attn_with_kvcache(q.unsqueeze(1), k_cache, v_cache,
                                        cache_seqlens=context.context_lens,
                                        block_table=context.block_tables,
                                        softmax_scale=self.scale, causal=True)
        return o

terms.note: 按它把这批新算的 K/V 写进分页 cache 的对应槽位。
解码时把逻辑块表交给 flash-attn，自己按页去 gather 历史 KV。

cards.name: store_kvcache()
cards.code:
def store_kvcache(key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor,
                  k_cache: torch.Tensor, v_cache: torch.Tensor, slot_mapping: torch.Tensor):
    N, num_heads, head_dim = key.shape
    D = num_heads * head_dim
    assert key.stride(-1) == 1 and value.stride(-1) == 1
    assert key.stride(1) == head_dim and value.stride(1) == head_dim
    assert k_cache.stride(1) == D and v_cache.stride(1) == D
    assert slot_mapping.numel() == N
    store_kvcache_kernel[(N,)](key, key.stride(0), value, value.stride(0),
                              k_cache, v_cache, slot_mapping, D)

notes.text: nano-vllm：~1200 行重写 vLLM。两件事交织——一个连续批处理循环反复吐 token，一套分页 KV cache 管显存。

notes.tag: 背景 · 一轮 = 一批
notes.text: 每次 step 只前进「一批」：要么给若干新请求做 prefill，要么让所有在跑序列各解码 1 个 token。
KV cache 按定长块切分，像操作系统分页：序列拿到的是逻辑块表，物理块可共享、可回收、可抢占。
逻辑块表 × block_size + 偏移 = 物理槽位。attention 靠这张翻译表把新 KV 写对地方。
显存不够时把队尾序列整段 KV 回收、状态打回 WAITING，之后重新 prefill——省显存的代价是重算。
只有被写满的块才算进哈希表，成为下一条序列的可复用前缀；没填满的块不进缓存。

steps.title: 总览
steps.caption: 两条故事线：蓝=请求主循环，绿=KV cache。先看请求怎么进来，再跟着一轮 step 走完前向与采样，最后看显存怎么分/回收。

steps.title: ① 请求怎么进引擎
steps.caption: generate 把每个 prompt 编码成 token、包成 Sequence 入 waiting 队列。请求此刻只排队，还没碰 GPU。

steps.title: ② 驱动循环：一轮 step 干三件事
steps.caption: generate 反复调 step 直到全部完成。每轮 step = 调度组批 → 跑一次前向 → 后处理落库。这就是连续批处理。

steps.title: ③ 调度决定这轮做什么
steps.caption: 有 waiting 就优先组 prefill 批（受 token 预算约束），否则给所有在跑序列各解码 1 token。返回 is_prefill 决定后续路径。

steps.title: ④ prefill 先要显存：分页 + 前缀复用
steps.caption: can_allocate 先探前缀缓存能复用几块、空闲够不够；allocate 据此建 block_table：命中的块共享(ref_count+1)，剩下的取新块。

steps.title: ⑤ 一次前向怎么跑出 logits
steps.caption: run 按 is_prefill 走 prepare_prefill/decode 建输入张量，run_model 跑模型（decode 用 CUDA Graph 重放）得到 logits。

steps.title: ⑥ KV 在哪读写：slot_mapping 之旅
steps.caption: block_table 经 prepare_prefill 翻成 slot_mapping；store_kvcache 按槽位写入新 K/V，flash-attn 再按页读历史。

steps.title: ⑦ logits 怎么变成 token
steps.caption: run 把 logits 交给 Sampler：按温度缩放、softmax，再用 Gumbel 噪声一步 argmax 采样出 token_id。

steps.title: ⑧ token 落库、块登记、序列收尾
steps.caption: postprocess 把 token 追加进序列、hash_blocks 把填满的块登记成可复用前缀；命中 EOS 或 max_tokens 就 deallocate 回收显存。

steps.title: ⑨ decode 怎么续显存：追加块 or 抢占
steps.caption: decode 每步可能跨进新块：有空闲就 may_append 追一块；池子空了就抢占队尾序列，deallocate 其 KV、打回 WAITING 稍后重算。
